source: Segment start times from the owner's Whisper run (2026-10-29); text is the English script for each segment.

segments.text: ILP brings you prepared clients and handles the follow-up after each call.
Members arrive with their question written down, and our team does the booking and chasing you would otherwise do unpaid.
You set your hours and read a one-screen brief before each call. Afterwards you confirm the summary, and we take it from there.
Joining is free and you keep your own practice. Work beyond a call is quoted by you and accepted by the member.
The application has seven short steps, and you can save a draft and finish it later.
